MP3 encoding in DIEZ uses lamejs 1.2.1 by Alex Zhukov, a JavaScript port of
LAME through jump3r, distributed under LGPL-3.0.

LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.net/
lamejs source: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
Versioned source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/lamejs/-/lamejs-1.2.1.tgz

The encoder is unmodified and loaded as a separate, locally served file.
It sends no audio to external services. The matching unminified encoder is
provided as lame.all.js; the original license is LICENSE.lamejs.
The complete upstream source archive is also retained with this delivery
in records/lamejs-1.2.1.tgz. Either encoder file may be replaced with an
interface-compatible version without rebuilding DIEZ.
